pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THIS IS GOING TO END UP AFFECTING THEIR BUSINESS AS WELL.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THAT'S WHY EVEN IF IT'S ONLY TEMPORARILY, I HAVE TO HELP PAY BACK WHAT WE OWE AS FAST AS WE CAN.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: IF ANYBODY WERE TO GET HURT BECAUSE OF SOMETHING THEY DID FOR ME, I'D FEEL AWFUL ABOUT IT...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: OUR FARM IS PRETTY FAR UP IN THE MOUNTAINS, SO IT'S NOT VERY EASY TO GROW ON, EVEN IF WE YIELD THE CROP OFF. WE WOULDN'T MAKE MUCH.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: OUR COWS ARE FINE AS WELL, SO MOST THEY WOULD STEAL WOULDN'T MUCH EITHER.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: WHAT ABOUT ALL YOUR DREAMS?!! YOU'RE JUST GOING TO GIVE UP?!

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: YOU'VE WORKED SO HARD TO BE THIS FAR!!

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: BASEBALL IS TAKING OVER THE FARM... YOU'RE RIGHT...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: THIS IS THE LAST OF IT.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I THOUGHT HE MIGHT BE BETTER.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: HACHI-KEN-KUN... CAN WE FINISH SCHOOL OKAY?

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: BE SURE TO DROP OFF YOUR TIME TO TIME.

pages.speaker: char4
pages.text: DON'T GIVE ME THAT LOOK. I'M NOT GOING TO LET YOU GET AWAY WITH THIS...

pages.speaker: char5
pages.text: IF YOU KEEP WORRYING ABOUT ME AND OTHERS SO MUCH, YOU AREN'T GOING TO LIVE VERY LONG.

pages.speaker: char6
pages.text: THINGS LIKE THIS HAPPEN ALL THE TIME.

pages.speaker: char7
pages.text: SO JUST LET IT BE, ALREADY.

pages.speaker: char8
pages.text: I'VE ALREADY COME TO ACCEPT IT.

pages.speaker: char10
pages.text: ALL YOU EVER SAY IS, 'THAT'S HOW THINGS ARE,' OR 'YOU CAN'T BE HELPED.'

pages.speaker: char11
pages.text: TRYING TO ACT ALL COOL AND COMPOSED BECAUSE YOU HAVE ACCEPTED THE UNAVOIDABLE THINGS...

pages.speaker: char12
pages.text: PUTTING ON A FAKE SMILE AND... ACTING LIKE YOU'RE FINE...

pages.speaker: char13
pages.text: EVEN THOUGH YOU'RE BOILING OVER ON THE INSIDE!!

pages.speaker: char14
pages.text: STOP SPITTING OUT THAT BULLSHIT SO EASILY!!

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: CAME BY TO GET HIS THINGS TODAY.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: HE TOLD ME THAT YOUR FATHER WAS THE CO-SIGNER WHEN HIS DAD TOOK HIS LOAN.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THAT'S WHY... HE SAID HE HAD TO DROP OUT TO WORK...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I TOLD HIM NOT TO WORRY ABOUT IT BUT YOU KNOW... ICHIRO-CHAN.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: SO LET'S JUST NOT TALK ABOUT IT ANY MORE, OKAY?

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: I DON'T WANT YOU TO BE BATTERED BY THIS.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: YOU CAN'T TELL ME HOW I'M ALONE AND HOW TO FEEL ABOUT THIS...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THIS IS THE CLUB WHERE INTRUDERS HAVE BEEN APPEARING RECENTLY...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: COULD I IMPRIDE SCRAM AGERA-PHOBIA... OR WAS THIS DESIRE...?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I DID AN INVESTIGATION WITH HARA-SAN IN A PLACE LIKE THIS ONCE...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I DESPERATELY STOPPED HARA-SAN WHEN SHE SAID "ONLY ONE DRINK..."

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: DO ONLY I FEEL FUCKING OUT OF PLACE HERE...?

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: NO WAY WHEN THE MATERIAL IS SO GOOD IT'S BECOMING THOUGHTLESS.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: THE DIFFERENCE IN TONRY AND ME IS WEIRD, IT ISN'T IT?!!

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: PLEASE THINK OF THE TALL GIRLS.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: THERE ARE HUGE WORM-LIKE THINGS ANYWHERE AROUND...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: TEN SAKO SHATTERED BEHIND THE HEADLINE OF "MODEL..." MIGHT BE A REFERENCE OF MR. CHILDREN'S SONG "DELINO."

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: WE HAVE TO SUCK IT UP.

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: AND WHAT'S UP WITH YOU, SASAKO? YOU DID IT ON YOUR OWN!

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: I THINK THEY ARE PERHAPS BEING LINED UP AS THE ACTION'S OPENING GLODS.

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: HOWEVER, THERE ARE A CONSIDERABLE NUMBER OF REQUESTS FOR TEENAGE TO 20S AGED 'FEMALES'.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: I ALSO TOLD YOU THAT I'M NOT LIKE YOU...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: WHAT HE'S STILL A BIT UNDERAGE, CAN'T HE?... WHAT IS HE DOING...?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: IT SEEMS MUCHANNO HAS BEEN DOING SOMETHING...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: I WAS INVITED BY HER FOR A 'PART-TIME JOB' JUST NOW...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: WITH THIS, WE CAN INFILTRATE THEM AFTER ALL...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: YOUR VOICE HELPED ME PULL OFF...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I wonder if I will die.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: HE SHOULD HURRY UP AND SURRENDER THAT BODY

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: KANEKI-SAMA'S RECONIZED WRITING FONK AS HE WAS COMPLETELY SUBMERGED...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: IN THE END OF TRAGEDY WAS BEAUTIFUL...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: LIKE THE "I WILL NOT LOSE TO TRAGEDY" TYPE.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: HE'D BE OKAY IF HAISE DIED, RIGHT?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: BEAUTIFUL WHITE KANEKI BACK TO ME...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: IT SEEMS WE'LL GET TO SEE SOME INTERESTING THINGS, DOESN'T IT??

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I FEARED NOTHING. I HAD NOTHING TO LOSE. YET I HAD MY FIGHTING SPIRIT.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THE SPIRIT TO CHALLENGE THE YOGHI-OKA ...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THAT TOUGHENED ME UP. SHARPENED ME UP.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: YOU WERE ABLE TO STEP INTO THAT PART OF MY LIFE, WILLY. DENSHI-CHIRO.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I LAY RESTLESS FOR 3 DAYS AND 3 NIGHTS.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: IT'S BEEN A YEAR SINCE THEN.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: YOU'RE HALF A STEP FURTHER AWAY NOW, COMPARED TO BACK THEN.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: SHALL WE CALL OFF THIS DUEL?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: Just enough distance so that he can't touch me.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: SNOW THIS MUCH EVERY YEAR IN THE CAPITAL?

pages.speaker: char7
pages.text: IF YOU DON'T WANT TO FIGHT THE DUEL.
